mapper.sql: SELECT USER_NO , USER_ID , USER_NAME , ENROLL_DATE , MODIFY_DATE , STATUS FROM RE_MEMBER
mapper.update: UPDATE RE_MEMBER SET USER_NAME = #{userName} , MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND STATUS = 'N'
